2609.01572.title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
2609.01572.paper_summary: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.
2609.01572.paper_summary_zh: 數據居住限制迫使企業自我托管大型語言模型（LLMs），但在不淘汰前代模型的情況下持續採用新模型擴大了服務艦隊，從而使有限的GPU池碎片化。我們通過關閉在生產錯誤分析中識別的質量差距，將來自200多個內部應用的流量整合到單一模型上，這些差距沿著三個軸進行分析：指令遵循、函數調用和內部任務分配。質量通過離線基準進行跟蹤，這些基準根據生產流量進行分層，並由確定性驗證器或經過校準的LLM評審進行評分。我們並不是共同優化所有目標，因為這會引入跨領域獎勵干擾，而是為每個軸訓練一個單獨的GRPO專家，並通過兩階段SLERP將它們合併。每個專家的獎勵揭示了不同的失敗模式，即語義崩潰、過度調用和冗長黑客，每種情況都需要特定領域的修復。在非推理模式下，該配方在內部Arena上超過了總參數基線的${\sim}7\times$，從69.6提升到65.8的指令遵循，從0.85提升到0.83的函數調用，從0.79提升到0.77，同時提升了一般對話基準。該模型吸收了50%的平台流量，每月116M請求，且服務成本僅為一小部分。
